notes.title: THE PERDITION MAN IS BACK!!
notes.content:
Hello,

I have been working on a new entry in The Perdition Man series called The Perdition Man: Winds of Judgment. It will be a horror adjacent First Person Shooter. Inspired by my nightmares, it will be a full campaign with local co-op. Please if you are interested visit the link below to the Steam Page and give it a Wishlist. Thank you all.


The Perdition Man: Winds of Judgment:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2498020/The_Perdition_Man_Winds_of_Judgment/

notes.title: The Perdition Man: Interval Soundtrack Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
Hello,

Thank you all again for your support. By playing my game you have made me want to work hard and continue to make content. I feel it would be a good time to make the soundtrack available on Steam. If you are a fan of my game or are feeling charitable please buy my soundtrack. It will be discounted 40% for one week. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421050/The_Perdition_Man_Interval_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Twitter Poll Results
notes.content:
Hello,

After conducting a survey on twitter, I found that in a close 1 - 0 vote of whether I should make a game at the same time as The Perdition Man (FPS), the result was that I should make a 2D shooter during development. This sounds like fun, as I mentioned I have already created sprites and have a general concept for this project so I am looking forward to it. Additionally I have an update on The Perdition Man (FPS) Kickstarter. Unfortunately there was not enough traction so I cancelled the Kickstarter. This means a few things. Firstly that there will be a soundtrack and artbook available to buy at the games launch in a couple years, and that I will be posting monthly updates on the game on Twitter. Thanks again for all of your support and I'm looking forward to developing some more games!

notes.title: Twitter Poll
notes.content:
Hello,

Thank you all for supporting my game I greatly appreciate it. Your feedback and engagement has kept me motivated to continue making games now and into the future.

I would like you to participate in a twitter poll that I have just begun about whether I should release a smaller game between now and the release of The Perdition Man (FPS) sometime in the next couple years. 

I have been kicking around the idea of releasing a 2D Shoot Em' Up and would like to see if this is something that you all would be interested in. Feel free to leave a comment on this announcement if you do not wish to engage on twitter. If there is interest in it I will try to make this happen. 

Thank you all again.
 
https://twitter.com/ThePerditionMan/status/1633860135264321537?s=20
